# Lab 14.6: Hybrid Search

## What We Are Going to Do
Combine semantic (vector) search with keyword search, and merge the two rankings with reciprocal rank fusion.

## Steps

1. **[SQL] Keyword-only search.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL

LIMIT 10;</span>

2. **[SQL] Semantic-only search.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT base.id, base.title, distance
FROM VECTOR_SEARCH(TABLE lab14.so_emb, 'emb',
  (SELECT AI.EMBED('split a big table by date to save cost', endpoint =&gt; 'text-embedding-005').result AS emb),
  top_k =&gt; 10, distance_type =&gt; 'COSINE');</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   The semantic search finds questions about partitioning even if they don't use the word.

3. **[SQL] Hybrid with reciprocal rank fusion.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">WITH semantic AS (
  SELECT base.id, base.title, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY distance) AS r
  FROM VECTOR_SEARCH(TABLE lab14.so_emb, 'emb',
    (SELECT AI.EMBED('partition table by date', endpoint =&gt; 'text-embedding-005').result AS emb),
    top_k =&gt; 50, distance_type =&gt; 'COSINE')
),
keyword AS (
  SELECT id, title, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY LENGTH(title)) AS r
  FROM lab14.so_emb WHERE SEARCH(title, 'partition date')
)
SELECT COALESCE(s.id, k.id) AS id, COALESCE(s.title, k.title) AS title,
       IFNULL(1 / (60 + s.r), 0) + IFNULL(1 / (60 + k.r), 0) AS rrf_score
FROM semantic s FULL OUTER JOIN keyword k USING (id)
ORDER BY rrf_score DESC
LIMIT 10;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **[Console] Compare the three result lists.** Rows found by both methods rise to the top.

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Keyword | Exact words only |
| Semantic | Meaning, even with other words |
| Hybrid | Best of both |
| RRF | Simple, no tuning of score scales |
